images.title: Three ways to write one number
images.purpose: Shows that 2⁴ × 3⁶, 6⁴ × 3² and 18² × 6² all rewrite to 2⁴ × 3⁶, which is 11664.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three cards in a top row, three arrows converging on one result card below.
images.exact_structure: Top row: three equal white cards with teal (#0072B2) outlines, reading 2⁴ × 3⁶, 6⁴ × 3² and 18² × 6². From each card one grey (#6B7280) arrow points down to one larger card at the bottom centre with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline, reading 2⁴ × 3⁶ = 11664. Exactly 4 cards and 3 arrows. Nothing else.
